coaching.headline: Steady strides, keep the heart happy 😊
coaching.coaching: Today's 6 km at 8:36/km kept your average HR at 145 bpm, well under the MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, which is solid aerobic work. However, the pace is slower than your target range (7:50–8:10/km) and you peaked at 159 bpm, so you need to tighten up the effort without letting HR creep up.
coaching.trend: Recent runs show you can hit the target pace (7:34 on 8/18) but it pushes HR close to the limit, while slower runs keep HR comfortably low. Overall you’re maintaining consistency in volume (16 km this week) and showing a moderate aerobic training effect (3/5).
coaching.nextRun: Run 7 km at 8:00–8:08 per km, keep HR ≤ 154 bpm, and focus on a steady cadence around 175 spm while aiming to reduce ground contact time a few milliseconds.
